mapper.select: SELECT p.storage_time FROM vm_order_package p INNER JOIN vm_order_devices d ON p.package_code = d.package_code AND p.order_code = d.order_code AND p.customer_code = d.customer_code WHERE p.delete_flag = '1' AND d.delete_flag = '1' AND d.customer_code = #{customerCode} AND d.device_code = #{deviceCode} AND d.channel_codes_str = #{channelCodesStr}
